text:
sam (CEO): thanks for the great Q&A today. tiny follow-up thread: one quick win/loss anecdote + one 2-week action. no essays.

luke (All-hands host): i'll collect these and make owners. pls paste short anonymized lines.

maya (VP Sales): win: marketplace startup chose our Dedicated tiers because of burstable capacity guarantees. loss: a medtech prospect required air-gapped on-prem install and an approved SOC report we didn't have. action: draft a customer-facing on-prem quickstart + list of SOC/compliance docs we can share.

alice (Customer Success): win: a B2B shopper reduced annotation backlog by using our sample prompts and eval harness. loss: a customer left after unexpected output format changes from a model update. action: CS+Product to add a "stable-format" flag to POC checklist and capture expected output examples.

jorge (Product): pattern: repeated asks for IdP/SCIM examples and clearer model-variant tradeoffs. action: product will publish an "IdP + model choices" note with sample mappings and recommended variants per workload.

ravi (Eng): tech note: we saw a few timeouts when long-seqlen requests hit KV cache under heavy batching. action: short-term: enable routing to a quantized lower-seqlen variant for affected customers + add metric. longer: runtime bugfix in next sprint.

tanya (Solutions): lost demo: couldn't demonstrate safe fallback during hallucination scenario in a 20-min POC. action: build a 7-min demo script showing fallback + a one-slide explanation of mitigation strategies for execs.

elena (RevOps): ops ask: please add anonymized loss reason lines to the shared drive; i'll standardize the Salesforce "why_lost" picklist so we can analyze trends.

ops-bot: follow-up doc created: https://internal/docs/allhands/wins-losses-collection. add notes by EOD.

sam (CEO): good. focus on shipping pragmatic docs and demo artifacts fast. if anyone needs a small budget or legal help, ping me.

luke (All-hands host): i'll assemble these into the follow-up checklist with owners and due dates and ping next Wednesday for status. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
file_notes: Short all-hands follow-up thread: one-line anonymized win/loss examples and concrete 2-week actions. Follows agents.md constraints (no title field).
